from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shlex,shutil,concurrent.futures,json
w=Path('/tmp/kanoni-no1pt-f64/clang');w.mkdir(exist_ok=True);ad=Path('/Users/admin/Downloads/adat.devel-rge-no_1pt/lib');cfg='/opt/homebrew/Cellar/adat/devel/bin/adat-config';flags=shlex.split(subprocess.check_output([cfg,'--cxxflags'],text=True));shutil.copyfile('/opt/homebrew/Cellar/adat/devel/lib/libadat.a',w/'libadat.a')
def build(name):
 cmd=['/usr/bin/clang++','-I/tmp/npi-feature-work/overlay','-I'+str(ad)]+flags+['-c',str(ad/'hadron'/(name+'.cc')),'-o',str(w/(name+'.o'))];(w/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2))
 with (w/(name+'.log')).open('w') as f:p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print(name,p.returncode,flush=True);return p.returncode
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:codes=list(pool.map(build,['corr_graph','hadron_corr_util','process_corrs']))
assert not any(codes)
subprocess.run(['ar','r',str(w/'libadat.a')]+[str(w/(n+'.o')) for n in ['corr_graph','hadron_corr_util','process_corrs']],check=True);subprocess.run(['ranlib',str(w/'libadat.a')],check=True)
